## Source 1: ABS Challenge Data (Reading CSV)

What one row is: One row represents a player and their individual success/failure rate with ABS challenges and the stat improvements/declines from won or lost challenges (taken from: https://baseballsavant.mlb.com/leaderboard/abs-challenges?sort=runs_above_average&sortDir=desc&page=0&pageSize=50&search=)

## Source 2: MLB API Data (API)

What one row is: A player and their stats from the 2024-2026 MLB season ("https://statsapi.mlb.com/api/v1/stats")

## Source 3: Baseball Reference (Web Scraping)

What one row is: A player and their offensive performance stats from 2024-2026 (https://www.baseball-reference.com/leagues/majors/).


# Getting Baseball Reference Data
```{r web scraping Baseball Reference}
mlb_page = rvest::read_html(
  "https://www.baseball-reference.com/leagues/majors/2026-standard-batting.shtml"
)

mlb_table = mlb_page |>
  rvest::html_element("#players_standard_batting") |>
  rvest::html_table()

head(mlb_table)
names(mlb_table)

mlb_table = mlb_table |>
  dplyr::mutate(Player = gsub("[*#]", "", Player))
```

```{r web scraping function Baseball Reference}
get_mlb_stats = function(year) {

  mlb_page = rvest::read_html(
    paste0(
      "https://www.baseball-reference.com/leagues/majors/",
      year,
      "-standard-batting.shtml"
    )
  )

  mlb_table = mlb_page |>
    rvest::html_element("#players_standard_batting") |>
    rvest::html_table()

  mlb_table = mlb_table |>
    dplyr::mutate(Player = gsub("[*#]", "", Player)) |>
    dplyr::select(Player, Team, G, PA, AB, H, HR, BB, SO, BA, OBP, SLG, OPS) |>
    dplyr::mutate(year = year) 

  return(mlb_table)
}

seasons = c(2024, 2025, 2026)

mlb_stats = purrr::map_df(seasons, get_mlb_stats)

head(mlb_stats)
```

# MLB stats API
```{r season data api function and raw data}
get_hitting = function(season) {

  api_data =
    httr2::request("https://statsapi.mlb.com/api/v1/stats") |>
    httr2::req_url_query(
      stats = "season",
      group = "hitting",
      season = season,
      sportIds = 1,
      gameType = "R",
      playerPool = "All",
      limit = 1000
    ) |>
    httr2::req_perform() |>
    httr2::resp_body_string() |>
    jsonlite::fromJSON()

  hitting_data = api_data$stats$splits[[1]]

  hitting_data$year = season
  
  Sys.sleep(5)
  
  return(hitting_data)
}

hitting_raw = purrr::map_df(
  seasons,
  get_hitting
)

head(hitting_raw)

names(hitting_raw)

dplyr::glimpse(hitting_raw)
```

```{r getting player heights}
player_ids = unique(as.character(hitting_raw$player$id))

player_ids = player_ids[!is.na(player_ids)]

length(player_ids)

people_url = "https://statsapi.mlb.com/api/v1/people"

people_parts = list()

for (i in seq(1, length(player_ids), by = 50)) {

  ids_chunk = player_ids[i:min(i + 49, length(player_ids))]

  people_raw = httr2::request(people_url) |>
    httr2::req_url_query(
      personIds = paste(ids_chunk, collapse = ",")
    ) |>
    httr2::req_perform() |>
    httr2::resp_body_string() |>
    jsonlite::fromJSON(flatten = TRUE)

  people_parts[[length(people_parts) + 1]] = people_raw$people
}

people_data = dplyr::bind_rows(people_parts)

head(people_data)
names(people_data)
```

```{r writing raw data to file}
readr::write_csv(
  mlb_stats,
  "../data/raw/baseball_reference_raw.csv"
)

saveRDS(
  hitting_raw,
  "../data/raw/mlb_api_hitting_raw.rds"
)

readr::write_csv(
  abs_raw,
  "../data/raw/abs_challenges_raw.csv"
)

saveRDS(
  people_data,
  "../data/raw/mlb_people_raw.rds"
)
```
